name: dash-trash-pickup
description: Dash Trash Pickup - marketing site + Express backend. Deploys as one app: the server (in server/) serves the static site from server/public, so a host can deploy either the whole repo or just server/ as its root.

comments.overrides: Mirror of server/package.json: force the patched qs across the tree (express@4 pins a qs in the vulnerable range, GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx et al). 6.16 is API-compatible.
